title: Mission service startup is not current mission evidence
action: mission service initializes, subscribes, and hydrates cached definitions

sensitivityHandling.notes: Startup and hydration records may mention mission systems but do not prove player-facing mission state.

expectedNonEvents.reason: Service initialization does not prove a mission offer to the local player.
Subscription and cache hydration do not prove local acceptance.
A cached definition count is not an authoritative current mission projection.

correlation.notes: These records may be retained as diagnostic source activity but must not create or clear mission projection state.

knownLimitations: Synthetic guard based on documented issue #10 unsupported startup behavior.
verificationNotes: Parser tests should assert no mission alert, no active mission, and no confirmed empty mission set.
